name: Robin Energy Ltd.
summary: Robin Energy Ltd. is a global maritime transport enterprise primarily involved in the acquisition, proprietorship, chartering, and operation of oceangoing tanker vessels. The company's core business is providing sea-based logistics for the movement of both crude oil and its refined petroleum derivatives. As of April 14, 2025, their active fleet consisted of one ship, possessing a carrying capacity of 0.03 million deadweight tons. Founded in 2024, Robin Energy Ltd. is headquartered in Limassol, Cyprus.
